failure_summary: Run 0 only: the served text inverts replyHistogram (afterBest 1 vs afterPlayed 3, reading key 'fewer means the tougher, more resilient defense') and closes 'your opponent keeps the strongest attacking line and has to work through a much tougher defense' — board-false, since after the played move (21522544) the opponent's immediate threat at c4r1 is gravity-top and wins on the spot (solver col4 = +17, no defense at all); the prompt stated the correct frame verbatim ('That is the toughest defense' is what runs 1 and 2 wrote), so this is model mis-anchoring, and on a PRODUCTION-FIDELITY run (gpt-5.4-mini) prompt_confusion cannot be separated from model capability.

On 21522544 the opponent's threat at c4r1 is gravity-top and immediately winning (solver score for display col4 = +17); the opponent faces no defense at all. afterBest=1 < afterPlayed=3, so the TOUGHER defense is the better move (column 4), which is what the guardrail and runs 1-2 say.
